name: Wheel of Misfortune
clause: Each player secretly chooses a number 0 or greater, then all players reveal those numbers simultaneously and determine the highest and lowest numbers revealed this way.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'secret-choice'; who: ScopeWho; what: { options: string[] } | { number: { min: number } }; then: Effect[] } plus the readers { count: 'chose-highest' | 'chose-lowest' | 'choice-tally', choice?: string } (Amount) and { kind: 'all-chose' | 'chose', choice: string, who: ScopeWho } (Condition), with `that-player` bound per player inside `then`
needs.semantics: Every player (or opponent) records a hidden answer — one of a printed list, or a number 0 or greater — the answers are revealed simultaneously, and later clauses branch on the tally: 'deals damage equal to the highest number to each player who chose that number', 'each player who didn't choose the lowest number discards their hand', 'if each opponent chose silence … otherwise … to each opponent who chose silence'. The engine has no decision kind that hides an answer until every player has given one.
